WITH sales_buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        1 AS r_reason_sk,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
            ) > 1071
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
            )
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
            )
        END AS bucket1,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
            ) > 39161
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
            )
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
            )
        END AS bucket2,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
            ) > 29434
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
            )
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
            )
        END AS bucket3,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
            ) > 6568
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
            )
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
            )
        END AS bucket4,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
            ) > 21216
            THEN avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
            )
            ELSE avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (
                WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
            )
        END AS bucket5
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
),
reason_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r_reason_sk
    FROM reason
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
)
SELECT
    sales_buckets.bucket1,
    sales_buckets.bucket2,
    sales_buckets.bucket3,
    sales_buckets.bucket4,
    sales_buckets.bucket5
FROM sales_buckets
JOIN reason_filtered
    ON reason_filtered.r_reason_sk = sales_buckets.r_reason_sk
WHERE reason_filtered.r_reason_sk = 1
